SLK.Floating.ImmediateBehavior: Sliders apply immediately. No Apply button is needed in this mode.
SLK.Floating.StagedBehavior: Changes are staged. Use Apply to update the scene.
SLK.Floating.Title: Lightkeeper Board
SLK.Fog.Hint: Token vision controls sight rules. Fog exploration remembers where players have already been.
SLK.Fog.ResetConfirm: This removes stored fog exploration for every user on the active scene. Scene walls, lights, tokens, and module lighting settings are not changed.
SLK.Fog.Title: Vision and fog of war
SLK.GlobalLight.Title: Natural and global light
SLK.Guide.ButtonHint: Open the very short Scene Lightkeeper guide
SLK.Guide.Lead: Open, choose, adjust, apply. That is all.
SLK.Guide.Note: The floating board is pinned: Escape, opening other windows, and launcher clicks cannot close it. Only its own X closes it. Fog reset still asks before deleting exploration unless confirmation is disabled.
SLK.Guide.StepAdjust: Move a slider. The floating board applies sliders immediately by default, so it deliberately shows no Apply button in that mode.
SLK.Guide.StepApply: Click Apply lighting after previewing a full-dashboard mode. If global settings stage sliders too, the floating board then shows Apply and Discard.
SLK.Guide.StepChoose: In the full dashboard, choose feeling, course of day, ordinary time, or Imperial Glocke. Merely changing that tab does not alter the scene by default.
SLK.Guide.StepFog: Use token vision and fog exploration separately. Reset explored fog only when you truly want everyone to forget explored areas.
SLK.Guide.StepOpen: Open the dashboard from the sun group on the left or the Scene Lightkeeper launcher in Foundry’s Settings sidebar.
SLK.Guide.Title: Scene Lightkeeper in five steps
SLK.Imperial.Hint: One Imperial day has 33 Glocken, divided into three watches of eleven Glocken.
SLK.Imperial.Title: Choose an Imperial Glocke
SLK.Moon.Title: Moonlight
SLK.Notification.FloatingDisabled: The floating board is disabled in module settings.
SLK.Notification.LayoutReset: Saved Scene Lightkeeper window positions and sizes were reset.
SLK.Panel.DarknessHint: The exact Foundry scene darkness value that will be applied.

SLK.Phase.Title: Move through the day

SLK.SceneSync.Off: Disabled — every scene keeps its own lighting

SLK.Settings.AutoOpenFloating.Hint: Opens the pinned compact board for this browser after entering a world. It remains open until its own X is pressed.
SLK.Settings.AutoOpenFloating.Name: Open floating board automatically
SLK.Settings.ConfirmFogReset.Hint: Requires a confirmation before clearing explored fog for all users.
SLK.Settings.ConfirmFogReset.Name: Confirm fog reset
SLK.Settings.ControlChangeBehavior.Hint: Immediate is the simple default: sliders and fields update the scene when changed, so the floating board does not need an Apply button. Apply mode stages changes and displays Apply and Discard. Bright-day presets remain immediate.
SLK.Settings.ControlChangeBehavior.Name: Slider and field application
SLK.Settings.DefaultCutoff.Hint: When automatic global light is used, stop providing it once the scene reaches this darkness percentage.
SLK.Settings.DefaultCutoff.Name: Default automatic-light cutoff
SLK.Settings.DefaultLightMode.Hint: Preserve is safest and does not alter a scene's existing global-light configuration.
SLK.Settings.DefaultLightMode.Name: Default global-light handling
SLK.Settings.DefaultSeason.Hint: Used for scenes that do not yet have their own Scene Lightkeeper state.
SLK.Settings.DefaultSeason.Name: Default season
SLK.Settings.DefaultSeasonMode.Hint: Used for scenes without saved Lightkeeper state. Calendar mode uses ordinary months in 24-hour mode and Imperial months in Glocke mode.
SLK.Settings.DefaultSeasonMode.Name: Default season source
SLK.Settings.DeriveSeason.Hint: Maps the 33 Imperial months to winter, spring, summer, and autumn instead of using the scene's manual season.
SLK.Settings.DeriveSeason.Name: Derive season from Imperial month
SLK.Settings.FloatingEnabled.Hint: Allows the pinned movable compact board to be opened beside the scene. Once open, only its own X closes it.
SLK.Settings.FloatingEnabled.Name: Enable floating lighting board
SLK.Settings.LivePreview.Hint: While immediate controls are enabled, temporarily previews darkness as you drag. The final value is saved when the slider is released.
SLK.Settings.LivePreview.Name: Preview while dragging
SLK.Settings.ModeSwitchBehavior.Hint: The safe default lets you inspect another lighting mode without changing the scene. Click Apply lighting to activate it. Immediate restores the previous behaviour.
SLK.Settings.ModeSwitchBehavior.Name: Lighting-mode button behaviour
SLK.Settings.SceneSyncInitialLoad.Hint: Also restores the last remembered lighting when the first canvas opens after login or reload. Leave disabled when each session should begin with the scene's saved lighting.
SLK.Settings.SceneSyncInitialLoad.Name: Apply synchronized lighting on initial world load
SLK.Settings.SceneSyncMode.Hint: Optionally applies the lighting you are leaving to the newly viewed scene. Fog exploration, token vision, walls, lights, and other scene data remain scene-specific.
SLK.Settings.SceneSyncMode.Name: Synchronize lighting when switching scenes
SLK.Settings.SeasonalEnabled.Hint: Makes sunrise and sunset earlier or later according to the selected season.
SLK.Settings.SeasonalEnabled.Name: Enable seasonal daylight
SLK.Settings.SettingsLauncherSize.Hint: Standard keeps the current Scene Lightkeeper launcher. Compact collapses it to a slim icon row to preserve Settings-sidebar space.
SLK.Settings.SettingsLauncherSize.Name: Settings sidebar launcher size
SLK.Settings.ShowFirstRun.Hint: Shows a brief guide once for each installed version.
SLK.Settings.ShowFirstRun.Name: Show version guide
SLK.Settings.ShowSceneControl.Hint: Adds the permanent Scene Lightkeeper group to the left scene controls for GMs.
SLK.Settings.ShowSceneControl.Name: Show Scene Lightkeeper controls

SLK.SettingsHub.HowItWorksText: Mode buttons can be inspected without changing the scene. Sliders apply immediately by default; global settings can require one Apply action instead. Moon and season supplement time-based modes.
SLK.SettingsHub.Intro: Launch the interfaces and recover their saved layout. A quick launcher is also available directly in Foundry’s Settings sidebar.

SLK.SettingsHub.TipFeel: Use How dark it feels when you only care about the result.
SLK.SettingsHub.TipFog: Fog exploration and token vision are independent, clearly labelled switches.
SLK.SettingsHub.TipSceneSync: Scene-switch synchronization never copies fog exploration, token vision, walls, tokens, Ambient Lights, or unrelated scene flags.
SLK.SettingsHub.TipTime: Use either clock when time and season should determine the result.
